Round-2's finding is only partially closed. design.md's API/Contract Plan section title now correctly reads 'Streams A + B + C + D, ONE shared staged batch' (design.md:371), its body states 'Streams A, B, and C each add one CI step' (design.md:373), and Global Constraints now states the batch carries 'three new suite steps (Streams A, B, C) plus Stream D's step-prefix restructuring' (design.md:522-529); infra-spec.md's CI/CD Sequence section and its 3-entry YAML snippet were likewise corrected ('Streams A, B, and C together add exactly 3 new steps', infra-spec.md:50-64). However, design.md remains internally self-contradictory elsewhere: its own Components table row for `.github/workflows/test.yml` says 'gains Streams A/B's new steps AND Stream D's...' in the Responsibility column but 'existing, edited via human-copy (Streams A + D, ONE shared staged batch...)' in the New/Existing column of the SAME row (design.md:117) -- naming a different stream pair in each column of one row. design.md's Layer Specifications table states 'one shared test.yml human-copy batch (Streams A + D); no new deployment target' (design.md:165), omitting Streams B and C entirely. design.md's own Security Boundaries table, B3 row, states 'ONE shared staged batch (Streams A + D)' (design.md:559), again omitting B and C. The identical stale 'Streams A + D' framing also persists in infra-spec.md's Runtime Dependencies table ('human-copy staging verification (Streams A + D's shared carve-out)', infra-spec.md:106) and Environments table ('the shared human-copied test.yml candidate (Streams A + D) is live', infra-spec.md:115), and in security-spec.md's OWASP Mapping table ('Streams A/D's shared test.yml human-copy batch...', security-spec.md:95). infra-spec.md's own Deployment Topology mermaid diagram (infra-spec.md:33-36) compounds this: it shows only two CI-step nodes under the test job (GDFSTEP for Stream A, and GNCSTEP mislabeled 'Stream A/B new step' though it is Stream B's suite) with no third node for Stream C's workflow-scenarios step -- contradicting the same document's own CI/CD Sequence section a few lines below, which lists exactly 3 new steps. Failure mode: a reader consulting any of these five-plus summary rows/diagrams -- exactly the kind of table a downstream implementer or quality-gate reviewer scans for a quick answer -- would conclude Streams B and/or C's CI-step registration either does not exist or is not part of the reviewed shared batch, directly undermining AC-019/AC-020's requirement that every new suite gets an explicit CI step inside the SAME shared batch, and risking the exact INV-006 silent-registration-gap this feature exists to close. This is a coverage/consistency gap likely to cause implementation misalignment across two of the four documents, so Major severity applies.

B3's stale '(Streams A + D)' stream-count annotation is a coverage/accuracy defect already captured under API-COVERAGE; it does not invalidate the boundary's stated auth/authz mechanism (human-copy staging + protected-file enforcement), which remains accurate regardless of which streams' content rides the shared batch.
